note: Fixed reference time per benchmark, in milliseconds. Score = 1000 * ref / median, summed over benchmarks. Each mark is the fastest median seen the first time that benchmark ran, written back by the runner. MARKS ARE ONLY MEANINGFUL WHEN DERIVED FROM A RUN THAT INCLUDED EVERY LANGUAGE: a mark taken from a Node-only run would hand Node 1000 points on that benchmark forever. sort, sort-objects, string-build, hashmap and crypto-hash have no mark because they were rewritten by hand; run the full set once, with all languages, to restore them.
source: đo lại toàn bộ ở 3 nhân, kiến trúc mỗi ngôn ngữ một container
